entry.title: New PyCon Portugal 2025 schedule released (0.16)
entry.summary:
A new PyCon Portugal 2025 schedule has been released!

We released a new schedule version!

We had to move some sessions, so if you were planning on seeing them, check their new dates or locations:

  • “(Pre-)Commit to Better Code” by Stefanie Molin (Sala Madeira → D -112, Floor -1 (Room Madeira))
  • “FastAPI Meets Langchain: crafting a RAG AI-powered chatbot” by Giunio De Luca (Sala Açores → D -114, Floor -1 (Room Azores))
  • “Building pure Django REST API” by Maxim Danilov (Sala Açores → D -114, Floor -1 (Room Azores))
  • “Advanced decorators – decorators & classes” by Rodrigo Girão Serrão (Sala Açores → D -114, Floor -1 (Room Azores))
  • “Understanding and expanding Python: hand-on experience with the Python internals” by Cristián Maureira-Fredes (Sala Madeira → D -112, Floor -1 (Room Madeira))
  • “The Pokémon trainer's guide to Polars” by Rodrigo Girão Serrão (Sala Madeira → D -112, Floor -1 (Room Madeira))
